results.description:
Keeper is a secure password manager and digital vault trusted by 5,000,000+ people and 100,000+ businesses globally. Rated 4.9 stars by 228,000 people, Keeper combines enterprise-grade security with real human support to protect your passwords, passkeys, files and private information. Named Best Password Manager of 2026 by CNET, and the Top-Ranked Identity Security Solution by Newsweek.

PASSWORD MANAGER FOR EVERYDAY SECURITY
Create strong, unique passwords and passphrases with Keeper’s password generator. Save them in your encrypted password vault, autofill logins across apps and websites and unlock your digital life with Face ID or Touch ID.

PASSKEYS AND 2FA
Create and save passkeys that sync across your devices. Store two-factor authentication codes directly in Keeper for fast, secure, one-tap logins without a separate authenticator app.

WORLD-CLASS SECURITY
Every record is encrypted on your device before it ever touches our servers – unreadable to everyone, including Keeper. Protect your vault with hardware security keys such as YubiKey® and remotely lock or wipe a lost device.

Keeper supports zero-knowledge security and advanced encryption, including quantum-resistant cryptography for data in transit. Keeper is SOC 2 Type I and II; ISO 27001, 27017 and 27018 certified; FedRAMP High Certified; GovRAMP High Authorized; and recognized in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Privileged Access Management.

MORE THAN JUST PASSWORDS
Keeper is your complete digital vault. Store and organize payment cards, passports, driver’s licenses, insurance cards, secure notes, SSH keys, software licenses, medical records and other important documents alongside your passwords.

Everything is encrypted, searchable and available across your devices. Automatically fill payment details, addresses and forms on websites and in apps.

SECURE SHARING
Share passwords, passkeys or files with anyone – even people who do not use Keeper – with a One-Time Share link that expires automatically. Set view-only or edit access, revoke access instantly and organize credentials in shared folders with nested subfolders and individual permissions.

DARK WEB MONITORING
BreachWatch® continuously scans the dark web and alerts you when one of your accounts appears in a data breach, so you can change the password before cybercriminals use it. Monitoring runs within Keeper’s secure infrastructure, so your personal data stays private.

PERFECT FOR FAMILIES
Keeper Family includes five private vaults, 10GB of secure file storage, unlimited devices and emergency access.

Safely store Wi-Fi passwords, streaming logins, insurance documents and passport photos in one place for everyone you trust.

24/7 EXPERT SUPPORT
Get help from a real Keeper expert anytime. Our dedicated support team is available around the clock, every day of the year.

GET STARTED QUICKLY
Seamlessly import passwords, passkeys and other records from iCloud Keychain, Chrome, 1Password, LastPass, Bitwarden, Dashlane and more, including direct secure transfer from other apps.

Privacy Policy: https://keepersecurity.com/privacypolicy.html
Terms of Use: https://keepersecurity.com/termsofuse.html

Thanks for your adoption of our Privault app as the final solution to secure your valuable personal photos, videos, audio memos and precious memories.

Privault (i.e.Private Vault) is a popular and high-ranking app on app stores of many countries. By far, we have ~4 million organic users worldwide and have reached a high 4.7/5 overall rating globally, and we are still committed to providing you continuous update and support.

Privault allows you to hide and lock your private photos, videos and files behind the locker keypad interface. The encrypted storage can be accessed only when you enter your particular digit-passcode.
This app has the best in class user experience compared with other similar ones, if you’ve already tried some.
Some major features you might use under certain circumstances:
Security:
-Primary Passcode: opens your primary secret space
-secondary Passcode: can be used as a secondary account, and opens a secondary folder. if you are threatened to disclose a passcode, disclose this one.
-Erase-all Passcode: used only when you are threatened and decide to erase all secret files
Photos:
-support a unique 3D Photo browser with amazing visual effects. Support image format: bmp, jpg, png,heic,heif,tiff,etc.
Videos:
-The media player can decode up to 150 media formats, such as mov, mp4, m0v, m1v, m2v, m3v, m4v, rm, rmvb, avi, wmv, 3gp, asf, mkv, flv, f4v, divx, mpeg1-mpeg4, vob, vcd/svcd, dat, mts, ts, gif, etc. You can import and play almost any media file.
Voice Recorder:
-This app embeds a voice recorder and provides a simple shortcut to quickly make audio notes/memos on the locker keyboard. In the settings tab, you can configure audio channel/quality/bitrate. It also supports lossless recording.
File Import/Export:
-You can import/export via iPhone camera roll or via an embedded WiFi server.

If you have any problem with the app, please contact: support@binspir.com
